text: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One of its main goals is text understanding. This means machines can read a text and find its meaning, not just the words. NLP is also used for translation. For example, it powers apps that turn English into Spanish in seconds. Another common use is sentiment analysis. Companies use it to study customer reviews and learn if people feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people online. They can answer questions and give help, which makes communication faster and easier.
